basic_info.name: Priyansh Raj
basic_info.current_position: Student at MSU - pursuing Master's in Computer Science
basic_info.content: Priyansh Raj is a developer currently pursuing a Master's degree in Computer Science at Maharaja Sayajirao University. He is a creative and passionate individual with a strong interest in computer science. Priyansh aspires to build his career in the AI/ML industry. Priyansh is currently serving his notice period at payguru as Junior Software Developer

professional_summary.THIS IS WHAT I WANT TO EXAMINE: Priyansh Raj is a passionate computer science student, currently pursuing his Master’s degree, with hands-on experience in web development, AI/ML, and computer vision.

professional_summary.content: He enjoys building applications, experimenting with new technologies, and is aiming for a career in software development with a strong focus on AI.
Beyond academics, he is an avid reader with a deep appreciation for cinema, often described as both a geek and a nerd.
Priyansh is steadily shaping himself into a creative, skilled, and confident developer.

unique_value_proposition.content: Blends academic knowledge with hands-on projects in web development, AI/ML, and mobile applications development.
Comfortable working across multiple stacks — Python, C++, React, Express.js, MongoDB, and Flutter.
Passionate about experimenting with cutting-edge technologies like RAG, LangChain, and LLM fine-tuning.
Creative problem solver who makes complex concepts look simple and approachable.
Strong admiration for innovators like Elon Musk and fictional geniuses like Tony Stark, channeling their drive into tech projects.
Balances technical depth with personal interests in books, cinema, and geek culture.
Shaping into a confident and skilled developer with a vision for a career centered on AI and software development.

career_goals.content: Strengthen expertise in software development and AI by working on real-world projects, contributing to open-source, and building a strong portfolio.
Build and lead a world-class engineering team at a high-growth company, focusing on products that have positive social impact.

Career trajectory is focused on growing from an individual contributor to a technical leader who can balance hands-on development with strategic thinking. In the next 2-3 years, Priyansh wants to take on more responsibility in system design, team building, and product strategy.
Particularly interested in companies working on developer tools and infrastructure, educational technology, sustainable technology solutions, healthcare innovation, and financial inclusion.

Envisions becoming a VP of Engineering or CTO at a mission-driven company, leveraging technical expertise to build products that solve real-world problems while fostering an inclusive and innovative engineering culture.
